title: Nine Winters of Naming
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（自然环境·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（自然环境·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：cause　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cause 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was asked to name the ① cause of a winter she could not explain, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② cause, meaning the reason and not the campaign, was a warm wind off the sea and was named by whoever came last; cause, she said, is the only thing in a winter that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ cause in that winter had the same shape, and the ④ cause at the end, meaning the one the scientists kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever named properly. Cause, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ cause was the whole of the century, meaning the thing we were fighting for and not the reason. The ⑥ cause, meaning the thing we were fighting for and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody serves and nobody questions; cause, he said, is either something you name or the only word that means both a reason and a fight. She said the fight is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ cause had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the wind. The ⑧ cause of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was a warm wind and eleven years of naming; cause, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cause I remember is the one at the end, which was named in 1974 and is still described as the one nobody had wanted. A ⑩ cause, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being named; every cause, she said, is a fight that has agreed to look like a reason. She said the fight was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 原因（指那阵暖风本身，与整个冬天相对）
C. 固定搭配：name the cause of 指出……的起因
D. n. 原因（指冬天里每一桩）
E. n. 原因（指末尾那一桩）
F. n. 事业（抽象：为之奋斗的那件事）
G. n. 那份事业（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: the cause of a winter she could not explain
The cause, meaning the reason and not the campaign
cause was the whole of the century
The cause, meaning the thing we were fighting for
the cause had become a number in a report
The cause of the whole thing
A cause, my grandmother said in 1979

answers.why: name the cause of 意为“指出……的起因”，1953 年母亲被要求说出那个她解释不了的冬天的起因。
cause 意为“原因、起因”，指那阵海上的暖风本身而不是那场运动，由最后来的人说出。
cause 指那个冬天里每一桩起因，每一桩都是同样的形状。
cause 指末尾那一桩（科学家保留的那桩），是唯一有人认真命名过的。
cause 意为“事业”，抽象指为之奋斗的那件事，父亲说 cause 就是那个世纪的全部。
cause 为抽象用法，指那份事业本身，是一个世纪里人人都为之效力、却没人质疑的东西。
cause 意为“原因、起因”，到 1969 年这桩 cause 成了报告里的一个数字。
cause 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是一阵暖风和十一年的命名。
cause 意为“原因”，我记得的是末尾那一桩，1974 年被说出，至今仍被说成谁都不想要的那桩。
cause 为抽象总称，祖母说一桩事业是唯一会因为被认真命名而变好的东西。
